section.p: Senior IT software engineer with over 25 years of experience in enterprise application integration, high-traffic Internet platforms and structured content systems. Strong expertise in XML / XSLT / XQuery, search engines, SQL & NoSQL databases, ERP/CRM/PIM integrations and microservices/data-centric architectures. Comfortable working with both technical and business stakeholders, leading migrations of legacy platforms and coaching development teams on modern practices.

li.p: XML, XSLT, XQuery, SGML, structured document systems, CMS and EDMS.
XML-aware & NoSQL databases (BaseX, Berkeley DB, dbXML), full-text search engines (Lucene, Vespa).
Enterprise application integration: ERP (Odoo), PIM, CRM, BI, payment workflows, EBICS/SEPA banking protocols, health-care data & HL7.
Web & backend frameworks: Java/J2EE/Spring, PHP/Symfony & Yii, Python/Odoo, Rust/WASM (PoC-level).

Architecture design, legacy platform migrations, multi-site and multi-country deployments, component-based and customizable platforms.

Multi-lingual documentation & publishing chains: schema-driven content, Web & PDF output (XSL-FO/PostScript), internationalization.
